title: Continuation Algebra Foundations
purpose: Elevate continuation from notation to a first-class mathematical object and establish the foundational algebra governing lawful RT continuation.

canonical_claims.statement: A continuation is the primitive executable transformation relating two lawful RT conditions.
The continuation, not the state, is the primitive executable element of RT Calculus.
States denote stabilized conditions; continuations denote lawful process.
A ->r B represents a continuation object whose endpoints are A and B.

formal_objects.name: Continuation
formal_objects.definition: A lawful process object relating condition A to condition B under residue-governed admissibility.

laws.name: Continuation Existence
laws.meaning: Every lawful residue continuation defines a continuation object.

laws.name: Endpoint Law
laws.meaning: Every continuation possesses an origin and a continuation condition.

laws.name: Condition Preservation
laws.formal: Continuation operates between lawful RT conditions.
laws.meaning: Continuation does not create arbitrary states.

laws.name: History Preservation
laws.meaning: Residue remains part of continuation semantics.

validation_requirements: Continuation defined as a formal object.
A ->r B explicitly references the continuation object.
global_validate.py passes aside from existing hygiene warnings.
